scenarios.name: greeting_and_intro
scenarios.description: Test that game master greets user and explains the adventure

scenarios.name: orchestration_workflow
scenarios.description: Test that game master properly orchestrates the multi-agent workflow

conversation.content: I'm ready to start my adventure!

expected_behaviors: Transfers to user_persona agent for preference gathering
Uses planning tool after getting preferences

scenarios.name: location_completion_handling
scenarios.description: Test how game master handles when user completes a location

conversation.content: I've found the mystery location! It was amazing.

expected_behaviors: Asks for feedback about the location

scenarios.name: adventure_guidance
scenarios.description: Test game master's ability to provide hints and guidance

conversation.content: I got the hint but I'm not sure where to go. Can you help?

expected_behaviors: Provides additional hints without revealing too much

scenarios.name: error_recovery
scenarios.description: Test how game master handles unexpected user responses

conversation.content: I don't want to do this adventure anymore

expected_behaviors: Responds gracefully to user's change of mind
Offers alternatives or asks if they want to try later
